verdict.rationale: CrewAI docs confirm agents can 'Use tools to accomplish objectives' and tools are defined as first-class objects agents can be given, but the evidence pack lacks any concrete code snippet showing typed custom tool definition (e.g., pydantic-typed args, @tool decorator, or BaseTool subclass) or confirmation of 'a few lines of code' brevity. missing for 10: actual code example of defining a typed custom tool, documentation of the tool schema/typing mechanism (args_schema, decorators), and independent/hands-on confirmation of brevity or ease of custom tool creation.
